about_the_game:
Grafika66 – The Galleries is an interactive virtual art gallery built in Unreal Engine, designed to present a curated selection of digital art from the catalogue that acts as a complement to the Grafika66 website.

The gallery offers 10 freely explorable spaces in 1st person, allowing visitors to navigate through a collection of digital paintings, limited-edition skate deck designs, and a small number of 3D sculptures. Each piece is carefully selected to reflect a blend of traditional and contemporary influences, offering a unique take on various forms and materials.

Features:

  • 10 Freely Explorable Gallery Spaces – Navigate through a series of exhibition rooms, each showcasing a mix of art in a minimalist, immersive setting.

  • Digital Paintings & 3D Sculptures – A focused selection of artwork, including fine art canvases, digital display panels, 3D sculptures, and skate deck designs displayed throughout the space.

  • Quick Navigation - Use the map to teleport to one of the 10 galleries, or simply take a casual browse through the first-person navigation.

Grafika66 – The Galleries is more than just a virtual art space—it's an evolving exploration of digital and traditional artistry. Whether you’re an art enthusiast or someone looking to engage with creativity in an interactive environment, this gallery offers a fresh way to experience modern art.

content_descriptors.notes: This virtual gallery contains a few artistic depictions of nudity, including classical-style sculptures of both men and women. Some images feature minimal BDSM-inspired aesthetics, such as masks, but there are no depictions of sexual acts, violence, or explicit content. The content is presented in an artistic context, much like in a real-world art gallery or museum.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 (or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i9-11900K or AMD Ryzen 9 5900X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3080 (or an equivalent high-end GPU)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
